verdict.rationale: Anrok's AI Atlas is a first-party AI that answers sales tax questions with its reasoning shown, grounded in the seller's own transactions, registrations, filings and certificates. That is the product's own non-generic tax assistant. Support rests on a single marketing line, and it does not say the answers cite the tax rule base or cover state taxability and invoice-level explanations. missing for 10: explicit citations to tax rules or sources, documented answers on per-state product taxability, documented explanations of why a specific invoice was taxed a certain way, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the product ships its own AI for tax questions — is this product taxable in this state, why did this invoice tax this way — answering from its rule base with citations, not a generic chatbot

citations.quote: Ask it anything about your sales tax and get an answer with the reasoning shown, grounded in your own transactions, registrations, filings, and certificates.
